name: redeemid/access-badge
title: Access Badge
description: Names the level an item needs, in the level's badge colour, with a lock for visitors it locks out. Reads the item's access rule, or a Membership Gate in its content set to an access level. Inside a query loop it describes each post. Shows nothing on open items, unless a free label is set.

options.label: Only when the visitor is locked out
The visitor's state (Locked, Included with your membership)

attributes.label: Label for free items
attributes.help: Leave empty to show nothing on items anyone can read. Set it (for example Free) to mark them too, so free and paid items read differently in a list.
